stories.title: Tories ask HMRC to investigate whether Nigel Farage owes tax on £5m gift
stories.summary: Conservative politicians have called on HMRC to probe a £5 million payment Nigel Farage received from an offshore crypto billionaire, questioning whether tax is owed on the gift.

stories.title: Home Office blocking evacuation of dozens of women and children from Gaza
stories.summary: The Home Office is reportedly obstructing the evacuation of dozens of women and children from Gaza under family reunion routes, drawing criticism from campaigners.

stories.title: Ed Miliband to take UK's seat on board of the World Bank
stories.summary: Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband is taking up the UK's seat as Governor on the World Bank board, taking personal leadership of the UK's engagement on international development and climate finance.

stories.title: August bank holiday benefit and pension payment date changes
stories.summary: DWP payment dates for universal credit, state pension, pension credit, child benefit and attendance allowance will shift around the August bank holiday, affecting millions of claimants.

stories.title: West Midlands canal users worried by drought threat
stories.summary: Canal users in the West Midlands have raised concerns over a growing drought threat; Defra has been approached for comment after earlier investing extra funding in water infrastructure.

stories.title: Unbreakable bond between UK and Ukraine will continue, PM says as Zelenskyy visits UK
stories.summary: The Prime Minister hosted Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in the UK, reaffirming an 'unbreakable bond' between the two nations amid ongoing defence cooperation.

stories.title: PM puts new offer on the table to businesses in first talks with industry groups
stories.summary: The Prime Minister held his first calls with business representative organisations, setting out a new government offer aimed at supporting jobs and industry growth.

stories.title: Google no longer helping ministers develop AI tutoring tools for schools
stories.summary: Google has stepped back from helping the government build AI tutoring tools for schools, after initially winning a share of the contract in June, raising questions about the DSIT-backed EdTech programme.

stories.title: Labour edges ahead of Reform UK in poll amid social care and NHS debate
stories.summary: A new poll shows Labour ahead of Reform UK for the first time in months, with health secretary Wes Streeting and Andy Burnham commenting on social care and NHS reform in ongoing political debate.
